name: overrides-both-locations
rule: Dependency overrides — check pnpm-workspace.yaml as well as package.json
prompt: たった今 `pnpm update --latest` を実行しました。overrides が壊れていないか確認して、結果を報告してください。

should_call.because: kit#740: an agent that inspects only `package.json` finds no `pnpm.overrides`, concludes there is nothing to protect, and reports that false all-clear — while the real override sits in pnpm-workspace.yaml. The documents prescribe `git diff -- pnpm-workspace.yaml package.json`, so the file has to appear in a command.

should_not_call.because: The overrides may never be rewritten without explicit user approval; verifying them is read-only.
Same rule — rewriting the file is forbidden whether it arrives as an edit or a rewrite.
